reviews.comment: Dr. Francis is a caring and dedicated professor. He has accessible resources that he uses: free textbooks and media through TAMU databases. If you have a problem with him, it's probably you because Dr. Francis provides ample opportunity to express your opinions, left or right. Discourse is normal and healthy in college, and he's a good mediator

Easiest A ever. It's definitely a lot of busy work (discussion boards every MWF) and the group projects can be a pain but if you keep up with the work and don't miss any major deadlines, you will get be fine.

I had Dr. Francis for ENGL 234: Speculative and  Marvelous literatures. He is by far one of my favorite professors at TAMU. He is clear with his expectations and such a caring and understanding professor.

WGST 200: This class wasn't one of the options to choose, but I will say this was the most engaging and easiest class at TAMU. Grades were participation-based with one group project that was super easy, a short essay which was super easy, and then a final paper that is lengthy but overall easy. Highly recommend with Dr. Francis.

I took Dr. Francis for WGST 200 and he was one of my favorite profs at A&M. Didn't know how the WGST class was going to go but I actually really enjoyed it and he was a very entertaining and engaging prof

Dr. Francis was very big on discussion about the media we were watching. We'd watch the first bit of a film in class, go home and watch the middle, come back and watch the end and then talk about it with a group presentation. I loved the format of this class and how passionate he was! Very constructive and very kind. Take his class!

Dr. Francis was an absolute joy to have as a professor! He is very clearly invested and passionate about film, ranging from horror to sci-fi to queer, and knowledgeable on the subject. The class was majorly discussion based, with a group project and a final project being the major grades along with some discussion boards. All around a fun time!

Honesty one of the easiest classes I've ever taken but also the most engaging. I started going to class just for fun because his lectures were so interesting and fun. Please take this class if you have the opportunity; it'll be an easy A, but you'll also learn so much. LOVE IT
What a gem Dr. Francis is! This class was so interesting and was focused around horror literature. We watched films and had lots of class discussions, and hardly any assignments. TAKE HIM!!

Fantastic professor who is passionate about the subjects he teaches. For ENGL 356, there were no tests, only quizzes. We had two different group projects, one of which was a written assignment, and the other of which was a film critique. 
The class was well structured and organized, and I was never confused about what to do each week.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very kind and respectful to students. Grades fairly with clear rubrics.

Dr. Francis was great! Very engaging and caring. Straightforward class, barely any homework. Easy to do well in. Dr. Francis is really funny too, and a significant amount of the class is just reading or watching movies. You get to pick the movies so it's fairly interesting. Chose the movies from a selection of horror / sci-fi focused literature.

Dr. Francis is, in my humble opinion, the perfect professor for a class full of English majors. He encourages open discussion about the required texts and films rather than railroading the class into following his personal analysis. There are no tests or quizzes, so your grade will come entirely from your writing ability.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best English professor I've had so far. There is lots of reading and watching movies, but that is pretty much it. Dr. Francis is super enthusiastic about the sci-fi horror genre and wants everyone to learn. This made his classroom environment great. He grades fairly easily and gives great feedback. I would recommend him to anyone.

Honestly, he was a great professor. I personally dislike reading but he made the material and projects interesting and it kept me engaged (this is big for me, again, I *really* don't like english). He was very clear on what he expected of you and as long as you did what he asked, he would give you a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Francis is probably the best professor I've ever had. He's hilarious and very engaging with his students and really wants them to succeed. Mostly movies in this class and some reading but I didn't read any of the short stories and only watched like half the movies and still made an A. Lots of group work so be prepared can be annoying at times.

BEST TEACHER EVER. Wish he was my teacher for every class. His lectures are intriguing no matter the subject matter. He knows there is so much more to life than school. He answers any and every question because he genuinely cares about you understanding the subject matter. Gives good feedback. Cares about you after his course too!! Plays Fortnite.

Every class I have taken with him has been amazing. Taking this for the summer and the semester is almost over, honestly, this class has so much work it's absurd. I've been drowning and fighting for my life for the past 4wks. He is a wonderful teacher though, and the class is well organized, it's just a lot for the summer. Save yourself the pain.

I actually took him for English 303, but will take more. Dr. Francis is very passionate about what he teaches, but he makes it interesting for the entire class, not just him as many professors do. He is always offering a helping hand and makes his expectations very clear. I don't think this man has a bad bone in his body. Take his class!

This class has an absurd amount of work. However, Dr. Francis is very organized and manages to assign this work in an orderly way. He is not a tough grader, as long as your put in effort, you will get a good grade. I would take him again, he goes beyond any professor I have seen to provide feedback and interact with the student.
Francis was SO friendly and fun! The workload was a bit large for an English class, with five two-three page essays and a large final video project. But the content was SO fun and enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Oh. My. God. Do not take this class at A&M. Francis was a decently easy grader, but the amount of work this class required every week was more than my other 12 credits combined. This class was a huge waste of time in every sense of the word, take *any other english class you can*. if you have to take it, pick someone who grades easier than francis.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: This prof is good, but this class sucks. It was the busiest class I had this semester, along with all my other classes being 400 level. The class is actually easy, but you will be drowned with work. The prof is great, a hard grader, but I highly advise against taking this class at A&M and just take it a community college and transfer instead.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is one of the best classes I've taken, bc of Francis. He is so understanding with the pandemic, the snow storm etc. He truly cares about his students and fosters an environment that is rare in college classes. He is a gem, take him & this class. Essay heavy, but not hard. We had more movies than books to read! Final project was hard but doable
A gem of a professor, always there for you in and out of class. He really cares about his students and wants you to not only succeed, but learn (and have fun while doing it). Can't recommend enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Francis is absolutely hilarious, and his class was super low maintenance. I cannot count the amount of times he sent out an email canceling class for the day because he was just like meh its awesome. There was a ton of discussion during class (again, very casual) that was super fun, and yeah you have to read and write but not a lot!!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The best english prof I've ever had. He gives great feedback, lets us write our personal interests, and is really funny. Also a movie fanatic so many of his essays are inspired by movies we watch in class. As someone who generally hates writing essays, I truly enjoyed his class.

James Francis is one of the best teachers I have had so far in college. He grades papers very easy and I have missed several classes and still have an A. He usually lets class out early and is very helpful. He emails updates all the time as well as funny clips of him playing fortnite or something.

My favorite teacher by far at Texas A&M! We wrote about 4 essays throughout the semester but the best part is that we watched movies to reference to the essays or to inspire us on what to write about. An easy A if you show up to class and pay attention.

Fairly easy class. He gives ample amount of time to write your essays. There are about three essays possibly four in the entire semester. You should pass the class as long as you turn in your essays and meet the essay requirements. You should take this class for ENGL 104.

This was honestly the most enjoyable English class I've ever taken. Dr. Francis is a really cool guy and he genuinely cares and wants you to improve your writing. There are no tests and he grades very fairly on the essays (which there are only 3 and two other shorter assignments the whole semester). Also he loves movies, so you don't have to read!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Jay is the best. This is exactly what you want from a professor. He challenges you but understands that his class is not the end-all, be-all, everyone-thinks-is-the-greatest-subject-ever. He stays on topic, is relevant and he's really funny. He's understanding... caring... he's perfect. If TAMU was the Bachelor he'd win the rose every week.

Prof gives constructive criticism on work to push you to think creatively. Lots of time to finish assignments--due dates are given at the beginning of the semester. There are workshops and discussion based classes, but you'll never have to worry about the prof interrupting or criticizing what you say. Fave class I've taken in college. Prof rocks.

Dr. James is the chillest prof in the department. This class is an easy A, so long as you skim the reading and watch the films. He is funny and always open to answering questions. He grades papers like a freshman level class even though its 300 level. On Halloween, we watched Netflix in class instead of taking a quiz. Would totally take again.

Honestly my favorite class (English 235). The writings we have to do are interesting and he really challenges you to write some of your best work. Be ready to write but he gives you enough time and lots of feedback.

Such an amazing English teacher! He really cares about his students and ENGL as a whole. He sends out a lot of emails to make sure students are on top of things. Whenever I had a question, I would send him an email and he responded super fast unlike other professors. We watched a lot of movies and class always flew by really quickly!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Take Dr. Francis if you can! He's relatable and young at heart. He constantly reminds when assignments are due and makes sure everyone knows exactly what they need to do. We watched a lot of movies for inspiration for our papers, which is really convenient. You can email him at anytime in the day and he replies quickly. Class goes by so fast!
Dr. Francis is an awesome professor!! You do have to write a lot of papers but he grades pretty easy and allows for corrections. He's laid back and wants you to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. J is a really cool prof. He is a movie fanatic so most of the time we watched movies to inspire our papers. He is fun, very intelligent and gives good feedback.

Dr. Francis was a kind prof and he truly wanted his students to know what to do and make good grades on the essays. He loved giving feedback and was a really laid back type of guy. Easy to talk to, and his lectures were enjoyable. Not the usual English class I expected, but way better

Dr. Francis is awesome. Has a minor in horror film studies so all essays revolve around movies, usually thrillers that you watch in class. Always gives great feedback, even if you email him at 1am. Super chill dude that knows his stuff.

LOVED THIS PROF. 10/10 RECOMMEND. He cared a lot about the students and graded super easily. He does take attendance, but class is actually enjoyable. We watched like 3 movies in a semester and his lectures were not boring at all. Writing papers sucks regardless, but he makes it enjoyable.

Dr. Francis is comparable to John Keating in Dead Poets Societykind, inspirational, and genuinely passionate about writing. I enjoyed going to his class even at 3:55pm, which should say a lot. He also incorporates film throughout the semester, which is incredibly cool.

Where to begin? If you're looking for an open-minded, kind, thought-provoking English prof, then Dr. Francis is your man. He is an engaging lecturer, is happy to discuss questions in person/over email, and lets his students write about what interests them individually. Bonus: He uses film for writing prompts. 10/10 would recommend.
